summary.text: Gordon Rogers is a Republican state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 21 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rogers took office on January 1, 2019, and was assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee and the Housing and Municipal Government Committee for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 9, 2026, and is on the ballot in the November 3 general election.
